name: Tape haze detune pad
desc: A hazy F-lydian saw pad worn like old tape: two voices where the second drifts on a slow sine detune signal (5-to-det cents) for tape wow/flutter, opposite-phase filter sweeps and a pan breath, a re-triggered pump in the groove and an octave-drop closing every eight-bar phrase. The lydian G-major glow behind everything. Macintosh Plus smog.

code.full: stack(note("[<f3 g3 a3 d3>,<a3 b3 c4 f3>,<c4 d4 e4 a3>,<e4 f4 g4 c4>]*4").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.08).decay(.4).sustain(.35).release(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.4,${gain}*.7).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}*1.1).slow(24)), note("[<f3 g3 a3 d3>,<a3 b3 c4 f3>,<c4 d4 e4 a3>,<e4 f4 g4 c4>]*4").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(.05,${det}).slow(16))).s("sawtooth").attack(.08).decay(.4).sustain(.35).release(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.4,${gain}*.7).fast(4)).lpf(cosine.range(${cut}*.5,${cut}*1.1).slow(24))).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(24)).room(${room}).lastOf(8,x=>x.add(note(-12))).orbit(6).play()
code.peak: stack(note("[<f3 g3 a3 d3>,<a3 b3 c4 f3>,<c4 d4 e4 a3>,<e4 f4 g4 c4>,<c5 d5 e5 a4>]*4").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.05).decay(.35).sustain(.4).release(.2).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.45,${gain}*.75).fast(4)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.4).slow(16)), note("[<f3 g3 a3 d3>,<a3 b3 c4 f3>,<c4 d4 e4 a3>,<e4 f4 g4 c4>,<c5 d5 e5 a4>]*4").add(note(${root})).add(note(sine.range(.05,${det}).slow(14))).s("sawtooth").attack(.05).decay(.35).sustain(.4).release(.2).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.45,${gain}*.75).fast(4)).lpf(cosine.range(${cut}*.6,${cut}*1.4).slow(16))).pan(cosine.range(.38,.62).slow(16)).room(${room}).every(8,x=>x.lpf(${cut}*1.7)).lastOf(8,x=>x.add(note(-12))).orbit(6).play()
